@@U02244@@
Ah, and the things / have to contend with! Day after day we do all we can to save, but day after day our needs increase, along with my troubles. The cooks, of course, lack for nothing. Wild boar, venison, rabbit, turkey, chicken, geese and ducks, payment in kind as secured revenue, these still come in fairly regularly. But we are short on wine. There was a time when cask on cask was piled high in the cellar, the best vineyards, the best vintages, but the endless guzzling of the nobles has drained us to the last drops. The City Council, too, has had to tap its stocks. They grab any mug or bowl to swill ic down, and the next thing you know they're under the table. So now I pay bills and wages with money from loans that eat up the future before it’s arrived. Our pigs haven't time to fatten, the pillow’s been pawned that we lay our heads on, and even the bread on the table is mortgaged.

@@U02246@@
(To 梅菲斯特, after a moments reflection.)

@@U02247@@
And you, Fool, what complaint do you have?

@@U02249@@
I? Why, none! None at all! I only look around and see the splendor of you and your court! Can confidence be lacking where Your Majesty wields absolute power and has forces to rout all opposition? Where goodwill is strengthened by ready intelligence, and energy of many kinds is at his disposal?
translation:
@@U02244@@
啊，还有必须应对的事情！日复一日，我们竭尽全力储蓄，但我们的需求却日复一日地增加，我的烦恼也随之增加。厨师们当然什么也不缺。野猪、鹿肉、兔子、火鸡、鸡、鹅和鸭，以实物支付作为担保收入，这些仍然相当定期。但我们缺酒。曾经有一段时间，酒窖里堆满了木桶，最好的葡萄园，最好的年份，但贵族无休止的狂饮已经让我们耗尽了最后一滴。市议会也不得不动用其库存。他们会抓起任何杯子或碗来喝下去，然后你就知道他们已经在桌子下面了。所以现在我用贷款来支付账单和工资，这些钱在未来到来之前就吞噬了未来。我们的猪还没来得及养肥，我们枕的枕头都被典当了，连桌上的面包也被典当了。

@@U02246@@
（沉思片刻后对梅菲斯特说。）

@@U02247@@
而你，傻瓜，你有什么抱怨？

@@U02249@@
我？为什么，没有！一点也没有！我只环顾四周，只看到你和你宫廷的辉煌！陛下掌握着绝对的权力，拥有压倒一切反对的力量，难道还缺乏信心吗？在哪里，善意可以通过现成的情报得到加强，并且可以利用多种能量？
